about: Tower standing on its base (FMC_S_StrFoundation_Base_TankStand): legs on base plates, mid rails, flat-bar X bracing on all four faces in two bays, ring beam, three deck joists, deck plate, front ladder rising 1 m above the deck, corner posts and guard rail. A 6 m ladder needs a safety cage per the safety adviser (not modelled). Each type has its own geometry where it differs (parts with 'only'); the rest is shared.
